stories.title: Over 1,000 GitLab servers vulnerable to ongoing RCE attacks
stories.summary: Over 1,000 Internet-exposed GitLab servers are still unpatched against a maximum-severity flaw actively exploited in remote code execution attacks.

stories.title: Critical Langflow Flaws Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Run Code on Servers
stories.summary: Two critical flaws in Langflow could let a remote attacker with no account bypass authentication or run arbitrary code, IBM said last week. Langflow is an open-source tool for building AI agents and workflows, and its vulnerability reports go to IBM. Every release from 1.0.0 through 1.12.8 has the flaws, and the only fix is version 1.13.0. Neither flaw is in CISA's Known

stories.title: Ivanti Patches Two More Zero-Days Exploited in Connect Secure Attack Chain
stories.summary: CISA has added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to its KEV catalog after the Ivanti VPN flaws were chained in zero-day attacks.

stories.title: Alpine Linux rebuilds GitLab after attempted RCE attack
stories.summary: Hackers attempted to exploit a critical GitLab vulnerability in Alpine Linux's development infrastructure on October 20-21, prompting the open-source project to rebuild its GitLab server and reset all passwords over concerns of a possible compromise.

stories.title: Synology warns of C3RB3R ransomware attacks targeting NAS devices
stories.summary: Taiwanese network-attached storage (NAS) appliance maker Synology warned customers to update their devices immediately due to a surge in C3RB3r ransomware attacks.

stories.title: Is Your SOC Ready for AI Agents? A Maturity Check Before You Deploy
stories.summary: Forty percent of security teams now use AI every day, and another 56% are testing it. Only 4% have no plans to adopt it, according to Prophet Security's State of AI in Security Operations 2026 survey of more than 250 CISOs, SOC leaders and practitioners. stories.title: Revolve Data Breach Impacts at Least 180,000 People
stories.summary: Hackers accessed its online shopping platform and stole customers’ personal and payment card information.

stories.title: Chainalysis Discloses Data Breach Following AI-Driven Cyberattack
stories.summary: The attackers used offensive agentic techniques to access the company’s systems and internal tools.
